Class Arena

java.lang.Object
dev.swordai.server.Arena
final class Arena extends Object
A walled stone platform high above the world. Plain grey surfaces and nothing else in sight, so the only strongly coloured pixels the agent ever sees are the colour-keyed opponent.

Once built it is left standing between runs and used again by the next one that starts near it; it comes down when another is needed elsewhere or the world closes (see ArenaServer).

    • build

      void build()
      Puts the structure up, or puts right whatever of it is not as it should be. On an arena that is already standing this changes nothing, and anything left lying about inside it is cleared away.
